name: Bruno Manfredi
headline: Solutions Architect & Technical Account Manager
pitch: I turn ambiguous business needs into technical roadmaps across AI adoption, legacy modernization, and engineering leadership.

highlights.text: Grew an SMB placement into a 30-engineer account across two companies and ~$20M in spend
Matched 700+ engineers across 200+ clients, lifting placement rate from 30% to 70%
Modernized core banking deployment at BBVA from days to minutes with a compliant PR pipeline

availability.text: Open to full-time roles: Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager or engineering leadership.

bio: I bridge the gap between complex engineering realities and executive business strategy. Across 15+ years in FinTech, banking, e-commerce, and automotive, I moved from back-end engineering and legacy modernization into owning end-to-end technical direction and client relationships.

Today I build and advise on production AI software—from React frontends and Chrome extensions to multi-provider LLM abstractions—focusing on feasibility, architecture, and what AI actually costs to run at scale.
Based in Piedmont, Italy, working across Europe and remotely.

projects.title: Artemis Quiver
projects.description: Production AI developer tool: React 18 & Vite SPA plus Chrome MV3 extension with four interchangeable LLM providers, local-first IndexedDB data model, and 144 automated tests.

experience.summary: Advising founders on AI feasibility and production costs while shipping developer tools and local LLM workflows.
Owned the full client lifecycle solo across 200+ clients, architectural discovery, matching 700+ engineers, and technical dispute arbitration.
Modernized core banking self-management from Java 5/6 and VB8 to Java 8 with Spring Boot, introducing automated CI/CD pipelines under financial regulations.
Maintained Disney Parks high-traffic e-commerce checkout microservices with 99.9% uptime, and contributed to GCP encryption service migration for Equifax.
Directed 2017 WannaCry crisis response patching 1,000+ endpoints over a weekend, owned plant software standards, and cut Level 2 escalations by 30%.
